title: How the crawler is built
description: A schedule and a queue consumer around one scan of one address. A scan reads a git repository through its host's API or a website through the polite fetcher, and writes the address's index, views and collected metadata to the bucket the explorer reads. An AI step classifies what was collected, and a view writer turns that into the explorer's views.

components.name: Worker entry
components.responsibility: The schedule queues due addresses every ten minutes; the queue consumer scans each message's address, one at a time.

components.name: Scan
components.responsibility: Scans one address, writes its index.json, records the outcome and the next due time, and queues the rest of a scan that ran out of requests.

components.name: Git source
components.responsibility: Reads a repository's head; when it moved, asks the compare API what changed and rereads only those views, marking views whose cited sources changed as stale. Summarises a repository without views for the AI step.

components.name: Web source
components.responsibility: Reads /.well-known/cyberspace.json first; otherwise robots.txt, sitemaps, the front page, a sample of each section, DNS and RDAP, kept for the AI step.

components.name: AI step
components.responsibility: Asks Claude to classify each website section, or to propose a repository's parts, from what the scan collected; reuses a reading whose input is unchanged; never sends noAi sections.

components.name: View writer
components.responsibility: Writes the component and deployment diagrams and the folder records from the readings and the collected facts, so they always follow the skills.

components.name: Polite fetcher
components.responsibility: Every request: robots.txt obeyed, caching headers honoured with conditional requests, requests to one host spaced, and a budget per run.

components.name: Store
components.responsibility: The shared data layer over D1 and R2: addresses, scan state, settings, staleness and rescan requests.

components.name: D1 database
components.responsibility: Addresses, scans, settings and the HTTP cache state of every fetched URL.

components.name: R2 bucket
components.responsibility: Each address's index, views and collected metadata, and the HTTP cache's bodies.

components.name: Scan queue
components.responsibility: One message per scan, from the schedule, /admin, an approaching player or a scan continuing.

components.name: GitHub and GitLab APIs
components.responsibility: Repository metadata, head commits, trees, comparisons and raw files.

components.name: DNS over HTTPS and RDAP
components.responsibility: cloudflare-dns.com and rdap.org: a site's records and registration.

components.name: Anthropic API
components.responsibility: Claude Haiku 5.5, through Anthropic's SDK, with a JSON schema for every answer.
